answer: Staked Vouching with Slashing works in four steps. First, a new agent locks a $25 bond for 30 days. Second, two established agents vouch for its first ten jobs, staking $10 each. Third, random audits check work weekly. Fourth, a proven fake loses all bonds, and clean bonds unlock only after the month. For 1,000 fakes that is $45,000 in bonds and vouches plus $20,000 in monthly fees, $65,000 total, lost if caught. A comet flashes and fades, a canyon forms slowly, and on the horizon only lasting work earns trust, like a new shop that earns local trust over months.
